title: callianthe laxa
intro: Callianthe laxa, commonly known as Laxa, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is used for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Callianthe laxa include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Callianthe laxa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
